description: awesome-citygml is a community-maintained list of open semantic 3D city models, started because existing lists from the CityGML wiki, TU Delft and others were incomplete. As of its last update on 18 May 2026 it lists datasets in 22 countries plus two artificial ones, 68 regions or cities and one worldwide set, with more than 215 million freely available buildings and 2.75 billion global LoD1 buildings. Entries are tagged by content (buildings, street space, vegetation, terrain, city furniture, textures, generic objects, historical data) and by level of detail from LoD1 to LoD4, and datasets not in a CityGML-like semantic standard are flagged; a subpage lists software for using the models. Coverage: global. Access: the GitHub README, with a Zenodo DOI and a 2024 ISPRS paper reviewing the datasets. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): MIT. Caveats: the list depends on community contributions, so coverage and links change. Simulation uses are locating semantic 3D building models for energy, solar, noise, flood and 3D reconstruction research. Related records: the TU Delft open 3D city datasets list and the OGC CityGML standard.
